statement: CISA adds a Cisco ASA or FTD vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-12.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog contains an entry with vendorProject Cisco, a product field naming ASA or FTD, and a dateAdded value between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-12 inclusive.
failure_condition: CISA adds no Cisco ASA or FTD vulnerability to the KEV catalog between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-12.

statement: CISA adds a GitLab vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog contains an entry with vendorProject GitLab and a dateAdded value between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: CISA adds no GitLab vulnerability to the KEV catalog between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-30.

statement: The ECB Governing Council leaves the deposit facility rate unchanged from its 2026-10-29 level at the scheduled monetary policy meeting on 2026-12-17.
resolution: The ECB monetary policy decision published on 2026-12-17 sets the deposit facility rate equal to the rate in force on 2026-10-29, as shown in the ECB Data Portal key interest rate series.
failure_condition: The deposit facility rate set by the ECB decision of 2026-12-17 differs from the rate in force on 2026-10-29.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting concluding on 2026-12-09.
resolution: The FOMC statement of 2026-12-09 announces a higher target range, so FRED series DFEDTARU for 2026-12-10 exceeds its value for 2026-12-08.
failure_condition: The FOMC leaves the federal funds target range unchanged or lowers it at the meeting concluding on 2026-12-09.

statement: The WTI crude oil spot price for 2026-12-31 is below 90.00 USD per barrel. Reference: 100.29 USD on the packet date 2026-10-29.
resolution: FRED series DCOILWTICO shows a value below 90.00 for 2026-12-31. Reference: WTI 100.29 USD in the 2026-10-29 packet market snapshot.
failure_condition: The WTI spot price for 2026-12-31 is 90.00 USD per barrel or higher.

statement: A new Israeli government headed by Benjamin Netanyahu wins a Knesset confidence vote between 2026-10-30 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: The Knesset approves a new government with Netanyahu as prime minister in a confidence vote held between 2026-10-30 and 2027-01-29, per the Knesset website and Reuters or Times of Israel reporting.
failure_condition: No government headed by Netanyahu wins a Knesset confidence vote between 2026-10-30 and 2027-01-29.

statement: The Democratic nominee wins the Texas US Senate general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: The Texas Secretary of State canvass, or the AP race call if the canvass is incomplete, shows the Democratic nominee receiving the most votes in the 2026-11-03 Texas US Senate election.
failure_condition: A candidate other than the Democratic nominee receives the most votes in the 2026-11-03 Texas US Senate election.

statement: Russia launches at least 500 drones and missiles combined against Ukraine in a single overnight attack ending between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: A Ukrainian Air Force daily tally, relayed by Reuters or AP, records at least 500 drones and missiles launched by Russia in one overnight attack ending between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: Russia launches no single overnight attack on Ukraine totaling 500 or more drones and missiles ending between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-30.

statement: The Victorian Court of Appeal quashes at least one murder conviction of Erin Patterson in a ruling delivered between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: A Court of Appeal judgment delivered between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-31, published by the Supreme Court of Victoria or AustLII, quashes at least one murder conviction of Erin Patterson, whether or not a retrial is ordered.
failure_condition: No Court of Appeal ruling delivered between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-31 quashes any murder conviction of Erin Patterson.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 200 km of the epicenter of the M6.5 Bonin Islands earthquake (USGS us6000u4r9) between 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-28.
resolution: The USGS ComCat catalog lists an event of magnitude 6.0 or greater with origin time between 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-28 UTC within 200 km of the epicenter of USGS event us6000u4r9.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 200 km of the us6000u4r9 epicenter between 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-28 UTC.
